hero.description: Discover the facilities of Valores Sinaí, designed for lodging, dining, recreation, events, and community gatherings.
hero.location: Av. Juan Domingo Perón 3251, Pres. Derqui

video.ariaLabel: Ambient video of Valores Sinaí facilities

espacios.label: Spaces for everyone
espacios.text: Children, youth, and families grow through education, culture, sports, and faith.

crecimiento.label: A place to grow
crecimiento.text: Transforming lives through loving our neighbors, solidarity, and peace.

beneficiaries.title: Who is this space for?
beneficiaries.subtitle: At Valores Sinaí there are no barriers or distinctions. Everyone is welcome, regardless of their situation, background, or beliefs.

churches.title: Churches and ministries
churches.description: Spiritual retreats, camps, worship gatherings, and activities that strengthen faith and fellowship.

families.title: Families
families.description: Meeting, recreation, and resting spaces for families looking to share quality time in a safe and natural environment.

youth.title: Youth groups
youth.description: Camps, sports activities, creative events, and gatherings that foster personal and spiritual growth.

artists.title: Bands and artists
artists.description: REC Pilar Sinaí offers a professional recording studio, streaming, and podcasting space for musicians and creators who want to produce with excellence.

events.title: Events and conferences
events.description: The main hall with capacity for 400 people and the conference room are available for institutional events, talks, and large gatherings.

volunteers.title: Volunteers and collaborators
volunteers.description: Those who wish to serve, learn, and grow will find in Valores Sinaí an open space to share their gifts and talents.

spaces.title: Valores Sinaí Property
spaces.subtitle: More than two and a half hectares in Pres. Derqui, Buenos Aires, with facilities designed for gathering, training, and growth.

posada.descripcion: Main lodging of the grounds, designed to host groups for retreats, camps, and multi-day activities.
posada.alt: View of La Posada, main lodging at Valores Sinaí

dormitorios.descripcion: Group dormitories for camps and retreats, comfortable and functional for different types of groups.

quincho.alt: Barbecue area at Valores Sinaí grounds

canchas.descripcion: Soccer, volleyball, and other sports courts, available for groups of all ages.
canchas.alt: Sports courts at Valores Sinaí grounds

conferencias.descripcion: Room equipped for meetings, seminars, and training sessions for medium-sized groups.

rec.descripcion: Multimedia building that functions as a recording studio, streaming, podcast, and video production place. Creative space for bands and artists.

taller.descripcion: Practical training space for developing skills and trades, aimed at community education.

dea.descripcion: The grounds have an AED available and trained staff in first aid: CPR, airway obstruction management, use of the defibrillator, and injury treatment, reaffirming our commitment to the well‑being and safety of the entire community.
dea.alt: Automated External Defibrillator available at Valores Sinaí grounds

juridico.descripcion: Law firm located within the grounds, open to the entire community. You can stop by during your visit or contact Dr. Aramberri directly for legal advice and services.
juridico.alt: Law firm of Dr. Daniela Aramberri at Valores Sinaí property
